name: Hono Open-Source Web Framework
free_limit: MIT-licensed Web Standards web/API framework that runs in local JavaScript runtimes and serverless/edge environments including Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun and AWS Lambda; no Hono software license fee.
watch_out: Hono is a framework, not a hosted free serverless account. Cloudflare Workers, AWS Lambda, Fastly, Vercel, CI, bandwidth and databases may bill separately; each deployment provider sets its own quotas, signup/card and overage terms. Preserve MIT notices.
